countries.title_zh: 出口强劲，政策利率上升
countries.read_en: IMF projects 3.3% real GDP growth in 2026 and 2.8% in 2027. The 2026 forecast is 0.7 percentage points higher than the 2026-07 edition.
countries.read_zh: IMF预计2026实际GDP增长3.3%，2027为2.8%。2026预测较2026-07版上调0.7个百分点。

driver: Exports and investment support activity in the central bank’s assessment. Higher rates can act on housing and financing-sensitive spending through a different channel.
央行研判认为出口与投资支撑经济。较高利率则可能通过另一渠道影响住房及对融资敏感的支出。
transmission: Export earnings, the won and domestic financing conditions connect the economy to equities.
出口利润、韩元与国内融资条件将经济变化传导至股市。
upside: If export strength continues and consumption broadens without renewed inflation, growth could spread beyond the external sector.
若出口保持强势，消费扩张且未重新推高通胀，增长有望扩散至对外部门之外。
downside: If inflation persists and further rate increases pass through to borrowing costs, households and financing-sensitive firms could face greater pressure.
若通胀持续，进一步加息传导至借贷成本，家庭与对融资敏感的企业可能面临更大压力。
watch: Exports, consumption, housing and household credit, and subsequent Bank of Korea decisions.
出口、消费、住房与家庭信贷，以及韩国央行后续决策。

title: Export strength meets higher rates
出口强劲，政策利率上升

downside: If inflation persists and further rate increases pass through to borrowing costs, households and financing-sensitive firms could face greater pressure.

outlook.title_zh: 预测上调后，增长预计放缓至2.8%
outlook.summary_en: IMF projects 2.8% growth and 2.3% annual-average inflation in 2027.
outlook.summary_zh: IMF预计2027实际GDP增长2.8%，全年平均通胀为2.3%。
outlook.market_divergence_en: The growth forecast remains positive while the equity index is below both trend averages.
outlook.market_divergence_zh: 经济增长预测仍为正值，但股指低于两条趋势均线。

propositions.text_en: Growth cools as inflation eases
propositions.text_zh: 增长放缓，通胀回落
propositions.derivation: Same release and periods; next minus current annual rates. Changes within 0.15 pp are described as broadly steady.

propositions.text_en: The baseline retains an external surplus. Its composition matters more than the sign alone.
propositions.text_zh: 基准预测维持经常账户盈余，其构成比正负号本身更重要。
propositions.derivation: Direction of the same published annual balance or debt ratio; no resilience score or distress probability.

propositions.text_en: The baseline moves from deficit to surplus.
propositions.text_zh: 基准预测由赤字转为盈余。
propositions.derivation: Direction of the same published annual balance or debt ratio; no resilience score or distress probability.

propositions.text_en: Debt falls relative to GDP in the baseline.
propositions.text_zh: 基准预测中债务占GDP比率下降。
propositions.derivation: Direction of the same published annual balance or debt ratio; no resilience score or distress probability.

propositions.text_en: Growth cools to 2.8% after an upward revision
propositions.text_zh: 预测上调后，增长预计放缓至2.8%
propositions.derivation: Country reading of selected published annual paths; exact rules and dependencies retained.

propositions.text_en: Export strength is lifting domestic demand while inflation and Seoul housing risks persist. Six members backed an increase; one preferred a hold.
propositions.text_zh: 出口强劲带动内需，通胀与首尔房市风险仍在。六名委员支持加息，一名主张维持不变。
propositions.derivation: Latest verified national decision; no predicted rate path or cross-instrument stance comparison.

propositions.text_en: The growth forecast remains positive while the equity index is below both trend averages.
propositions.text_zh: 经济增长预测仍为正值，但股指低于两条趋势均线。
propositions.derivation: Separate annual GDP forecast and dated 50/200-observation price trends; no causal or valuation inference.

world_brief.title_en: Global growth is forecast to strengthen in 2027.

world_brief.mechanism_en: AI investment supports technology supply chains; expensive energy weighs on purchasing power. Countries can face both forces.

balances.reading_zh: 基准预测由赤字转为盈余。

balances.coverage_note: Central and local government, including social security funds; accrual basis. The overall balance differs from Korea's managed fiscal balance.

balances.reading_zh: 基准预测中债务占GDP比率下降。

outlook.title_en: Growth cools to 2.8% after an upward revision
outlook.title_zh: 预测上调后，增长预计放缓至2.8%
outlook.summary_en: IMF projects 2.8% growth and 2.3% annual-average inflation in 2027.
outlook.summary_zh: IMF预计2027实际GDP增长2.8%，全年平均通胀为2.3%。
outlook.market_divergence_en: The growth forecast remains positive while the equity index is below both trend averages.
outlook.market_divergence_zh: 经济增长预测仍为正值，但股指低于两条趋势均线。

propositions.text_en: Growth cools as inflation eases
propositions.text_zh: 增长放缓，通胀回落
propositions.derivation: Same release and periods; next minus current annual rates. Changes within 0.15 pp are described as broadly steady.

propositions.text_en: The baseline retains an external surplus. Its composition matters more than the sign alone.
propositions.text_zh: 基准预测维持经常账户盈余，其构成比正负号本身更重要。
propositions.derivation: Direction of the same published annual balance or debt ratio; no resilience score or distress probability.

propositions.text_en: The baseline moves from deficit to surplus.
propositions.text_zh: 基准预测由赤字转为盈余。
propositions.derivation: Direction of the same published annual balance or debt ratio; no resilience score or distress probability.

propositions.text_en: Debt falls relative to GDP in the baseline.
propositions.text_zh: 基准预测中债务占GDP比率下降。
propositions.derivation: Direction of the same published annual balance or debt ratio; no resilience score or distress probability.

propositions.text_en: Growth cools to 2.8% after an upward revision
propositions.text_zh: 预测上调后，增长预计放缓至2.8%
propositions.derivation: Country reading of selected published annual paths; exact rules and dependencies retained.

propositions.text_en: Export strength is lifting domestic demand while inflation and Seoul housing risks persist. Six members backed an increase; one preferred a hold.
propositions.text_zh: 出口强劲带动内需，通胀与首尔房市风险仍在。六名委员支持加息，一名主张维持不变。
propositions.derivation: Latest verified national decision; no predicted rate path or cross-instrument stance comparison.

propositions.text_en: The growth forecast remains positive while the equity index is below both trend averages.
propositions.text_zh: 经济增长预测仍为正值，但股指低于两条趋势均线。
propositions.derivation: Separate annual GDP forecast and dated 50/200-observation price trends; no causal or valuation inference.

propositions.text_en: Export strength meets higher rates
propositions.text_zh: 出口强劲，政策利率上升
propositions.derivation: Reviewed country mechanism; requalified from current evidence on every build.
